abuse-address.description: Postal address of the abuse contact for the network the IP address belongs to

abuse-country.description: Country code of the abuse contact

abuse-email.description: Email address of the abuse contact

abuse-organization.description: Organisation of the abuse contact, or its registry handle

abuse-phone.description: Phone number of the abuse contact

abuse-route.description: Network range (CIDR) the abuse contact is responsible for

bot-confidence-score.description: Confidence that the IP address is used by bots, from 0 to 100

bot-last-seen.description: Last time the IP address was seen used by bots

bot-operator.description: Name of the operator of the bot

bot-type.description: Type of bot, such as crawler or monitoring

cloud-provider.description: Name of the cloud or hosting provider the IP address belongs to

company-domain.description: Domain of the company or ISP using the IP address

company-name.description: Name of the company or ISP using the IP address

company-type.description: Type of the company using the IP address, such as ISP, hosting or business

corporate-gateway-provider.description: Name of the corporate gateway provider

ip.description: IP address the information refers to

is-anonymous.description: The IP address hides the identity of its user (VPN, proxy, Tor or relay)

is-bot.description: The IP address is used by bots

is-cloud-provider.description: The IP address belongs to a cloud or hosting provider

is-corporate-gateway.description: The IP address is a corporate gateway, such as a secure web gateway or zero-trust egress

is-known-attacker.description: The IP address has been seen attacking other systems

is-known-good-bot.description: The IP address belongs to a known legitimate crawler or bot, such as a search engine

is-proxy.description: The IP address is a proxy

is-relay.description: The IP address is part of a relay network, such as iCloud Private Relay

is-residential-proxy.description: The IP address is a residential proxy

is-spam.description: The IP address has been seen sending spam

is-tor.description: The IP address is a Tor exit node

is-vpn.description: The IP address is a VPN exit point

proxy-confidence-score.description: Confidence that the IP address is a proxy, from 0 to 100

proxy-last-seen.description: Last time the IP address was seen as a proxy

threat-score.description: IPGeolocation.io threat score, from 0 to 100; higher is riskier

vpn-confidence-score.description: Confidence that the IP address is a VPN exit point, from 0 to 100

vpn-last-seen.description: Last time the IP address was seen as a VPN exit point

description: IP address intelligence from IPGeolocation.io: threat score, anonymisation signals (VPN, proxy, Tor, relay), bot, spam and attacker flags, hosting provider, company and abuse contact.
name: ipgeolocation-ip
